paper.title: Cross-Regime Measurement Failure in the KT3b Environmental Test

kt3b_measurement_chain.original_observable: R = g_obs / g_bar at g_bar ~ a_0
kt3b_measurement_chain.original_driver: tidal environment Theta_1 or group membership N_mem
kt3b_measurement_chain.signal_collapse_pattern: monotonic collapse as confounders are removed; standard interpretation 'effect too small for SPARC' rejected in favour of structural diagnosis

regime_mismatch.why: Non-linear galactic dynamics; grid-mode activation at g < a_0
Large-scale structure; Mpc-scale density field; linear perturbation theory
Transition point where the regime changes; maximally unstable
Stellar population synthesis assumes universal IMF and standard gravity

boundary_physics_at_a0.R_of_k_transition: R >> 1 (L1, suppressed growth) -> R << 1 (L2, enhanced gravity)
boundary_physics_at_a0.rar_scatter: maximal at g ~ a_0 (McGaugh, Lelli & Schombert 2016)
boundary_physics_at_a0.analogy: measuring a phase transition at the critical temperature: fluctuations diverge and S/N collapses
boundary_physics_at_a0.fisher_information: R(a_0) has intrinsically low Fisher information with respect to cross-regime parameters such as alpha, because mu(k) fluctuations dominate over the mean signal from any cross-regime coupling

rcmp_violations.name: Driver-response mismatch
rcmp_violations.statement: rho_env (L1) drives D_eff (L2) through an underived alpha operator

rcmp_violations.name: Boundary observation
rcmp_violations.statement: R at a_0 sits on the L1/L2 boundary where both regimes contribute and neither dominates

rcmp_violations.name: Implicit regime mixing in mass model
rcmp_violations.statement: Upsilon_star = 0.5 M_sun/L_sun assumes L1-regime stellar physics applied to L2-regime gravitational dynamics

rcmp_violation_sufficiency: Any one of V1/V2/V3 is sufficient to degrade the measurement; together they explain the systematic collapse of the signal across all four runs.

missing_properties: physical mechanism from Mpc-scale density to kpc-scale mode activation
uniqueness of the mapping rho_env -> D_eff
undefined_alpha_operator.consequence: alpha is not a physical parameter; it is an effective fit coefficient absorbing all cross-regime effects indiscriminately

A_pure_L2.observable: RAR slope d log(g_obs/g_bar) / d log g_bar at 1e-2 < g_bar/a_0 < 1e-1

B_pure_L1.observable: fsigma8(z) from RSD or void-cluster growth rate comparison

C_derived_mapping.observable: same as KT3b but with derived alpha(k, z) rather than free parameter
C_derived_mapping.requirement: solve the coupled (g_mu_nu, S) system across scales

applies_to: MOND External Field Effect tests using R at a_0
any framework where a_0 marks a regime boundary and environmental coupling is measured at that boundary
scope_of_diagnosis.why_stronger_than_null: The diagnosis identifies a structural constraint on any test that attempts to connect large-scale environment to galactic dynamics in a regime-structured theory. It applies independently of which specific cross-regime theory (EFC, MOND EFE, Verlinde, ...) is being tested.
